# GatorpH

## Installation

You can install the development version of GatorpH from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

remotes::install_github("OmarAshkar/GatorpH")
```

## GatorpH User Interface

The server-based graphical interface of `GatorpH` can be accessed at
<https://app.cop.ufl.edu/gatorph/>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calc_time_under_pH()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/calc_time_under_pH.md)
  : Calculate Time Under pH Threshold
- [`fit_individual_plot()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/fit_individual_plot.md)
  : Plot Individual pH Profiles
- [`fit_obs_vs_ipred_plot()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/fit_obs_vs_ipred_plot.md)
  : Plot Observed vs Predicted pH
- [`fit_pH_curve()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/fit_pH_curve.md)
  : Fit pH Curve using NLME
- [`format_metrics_tab()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/format_metrics_tab.md)
  : Format pH Metrics Table
- [`integratepHArea()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/integratepHArea.md)
  : Integrate Area Under pH Threshold Calculates the area under the pH
  curve below a specified pH threshold using the trapezoidal rule. It
  assumes the flipped shape
- [`kpd_mod()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/kpd_mod.md)
  : KPD Model
- [`kpd_mod2()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/kpd_mod2.md)
  : KPD Model with Linear Parameterization
- [`pHMetrics_from_fit()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/pHMetrics_from_fit.md)
  : Get pH Metrics from NLME Fit
- [`plot_pH_time()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/plot_pH_time.md)
  : Plot pH vs Time with Threshold
- [`read_pH()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/read_pH.md)
  : Read pH Data
- [`run_direct_estimation()`](https://omarashkar.github.io/GatorpH/reference/run_direct_estimation.md)
  : Run direct estimation for pH data
